parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 20.4.1 Fool's Hunt!
Meta Support Unit
This unit has one of the BEST supporting abilities in-game!

Overview

Siren (Harpy) is a MythicalMythical unit. She is only obtainable by evolving Siren.

Evolving

Siren (Harpy) can be evolved from Siren with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Siren
x1 Snow Wings
x12 Star Fruit
x3 Star Fruit (Blue)
x4 Star Fruit (Pink)
x4 Star Fruit (Green)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Siren (Harpy)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 5000 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their total cost.

Trivia

  • Siren's Perfect SPA is about 7s. For Perfect SPA on her Permafrost attack (Upgrade 4-5), Siren needs about 8s SPA on placement. For Perfect SPA on her Snow Dome attack (Upgrade 6-8), Siren needs about 8.5s SPA on placement.

    The Snow Wings can be purchased for 5,000 stars in the lobby.


  1. ↑ Takedowns refer to kills or assists
